title: 666 Tattoo & Antiques
body: A unique blend of decades of tattoo expertise, a passion for antiques and a love of great coffee - all in one place.

title: Tattoo
body: Different specialty styles of tattoo with a combined expertise of over 30 years, from traditional and Japanese to fine line, blackwork and realism.

title: Antiques
body: A curated collection of hand-picked antiques that are funky, grungy and different.

title: Coffee
body: A relaxed coffee shop atmosphere and some of the best coffee on the northside of Brisbane. Grab one while you browse or wait for your appointment.

title: Our tattoo artists
body: Each of our tattoo artists specialise in different areas of tattoo, and are all based out of our Lawnton shop in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.

title: What we're about
body:
We are a unique shop for unique folks.

We offer different specialty types of tattoos with a combined expertise of over 30 years, alongside a curated collection of hand-picked antiques that are funky, grungy and different. With both of these passions, we could only top it off by adding a relaxed coffee shop atmosphere and some of the best coffee on the northside of Brisbane.

title: What we do
body:
Our team are well versed in the Australian, and more specifically Queensland, tattoo industry with plenty of experience and knowledge to ensure your next tattoo is the best it can be.

We remain committed to the best experience; meaning we have a tonne of other services and products you can check out while you're in the shop. We stock gift vouchers, merchandise, the best aftercare tattoo products possible and we strive to exceed your expectations.
